math3-multiplication-meaning.title: School Store Shelves
math3-multiplication-meaning.tagline: Stock the school store with equal groups and arrays, then write a shelf plan.
math3-multiplication-meaning.description: Students stock a school store. They model packs of supplies as equal groups, arrange items in arrays, write multiplication equations and solve store word problems.

math3-division-meaning.title: Field Day Teams
math3-division-meaning.tagline: Split the class into fair teams and share the equipment equally.
math3-division-meaning.description: Students plan Field Day. They share equipment equally (how many in each group), make teams of a given size (how many groups), write division equations and check with multiplication.

math3-properties-fact-strategies.title: Bakery Boxes
math3-properties-fact-strategies.tagline: Fill bakery orders using properties and fact strategies to multiply quickly.
math3-properties-fact-strategies.description: Students run a bakery. They pack muffins in trays and boxes, turn arrays (commutative), regroup trays and boxes (associative), break hard facts into easier ones (distributive) and explain their strategies.

math3-addition-subtraction-1000.title: Read‑a‑Thon Report
math3-addition-subtraction-1000.tagline: Total the pages read, compare classes and report rounded results.
math3-addition-subtraction-1000.description: Students run the school Read-a-Thon. They add and subtract page counts within 1,000, round totals to the nearest 10 and 100 for a news report, and use estimates to check answers.

math3-patterns-unknowns-two-step.title: Class Celebration Planner
math3-patterns-unknowns-two-step.tagline: Plan a class party with two-step problems, unknowns and multiples of 10.
math3-patterns-unknowns-two-step.description: Students plan a class celebration. They buy supplies in packs, find unknown numbers, multiply by multiples of 10, write equations with a letter for two-step problems and check that the plan is reasonable.

math3-patterns-unknowns-two-step.title: School Fun Fair
math3-patterns-unknowns-two-step.tagline: Run game booths, share prizes and balance the fair budget (Units 1–5).
math3-patterns-unknowns-two-step.description: A cumulative project for Units 1–5. Students plan a school fun fair: tickets sold in equal groups, prizes shared equally among booths, fact strategies for prices, totals within 1,000 with rounding, and two-step budget problems with equations.

math3-understanding-fractions.title: Garden Plot Fractions
math3-understanding-fractions.tagline: Split garden beds into equal parts and mark a fraction trail.
math3-understanding-fractions.description: Students plan a class garden. They split beds into equal parts, name unit fractions and fractions built from unit fractions, and place trail markers on a fraction number line.

math3-equivalent-comparing-fractions.title: The Ribbon Shop
math3-equivalent-comparing-fractions.tagline: Cut, match and compare ribbon orders using equivalent fractions.
math3-equivalent-comparing-fractions.description: Students run a ribbon shop where every ribbon is 1 yard long. They match equivalent orders on fraction strips, write whole numbers as fractions, and compare orders with the same numerator or the same denominator.

math3-time-volume-mass.title: Science Museum Day
math3-time-volume-mass.tagline: Build a field-trip schedule and run a water-and-mass lab.
math3-time-volume-mass.description: Students plan a day at a science museum. They read clocks, build a schedule with elapsed time, and at the lab station measure and solve problems with liters, grams and kilograms.
math3-time-volume-mass.product: Museum Day Schedule and Lab Sheet

math3-graphs-measurement-data.title: Class Survey and Data Report
math3-graphs-measurement-data.tagline: Run a class survey, draw scaled graphs and measure pencils for a line plot.
math3-graphs-measurement-data.description: Students run an anonymous class survey (no names), show the results in a scaled picture graph and a scaled bar graph, answer how-many-more questions, and measure pencils to the nearest quarter inch for a line plot.

math3-area.title: Design a Reading Nook
math3-area.tagline: Plan a cozy reading nook with rugs, mats and an L‑shaped corner, using area.
math3-area.description: Students design a classroom reading nook on grid paper. They count square units, multiply side lengths, split rectangles with the distributive property and find the area of an L‑shaped corner.

math3-perimeter-shapes.title: Playground Designer
math3-perimeter-shapes.tagline: Fence the play areas, compare perimeter and area, and use quadrilaterals in the design.
math3-perimeter-shapes.description: Students design a playground. They find perimeters and missing side lengths for fences, compare rectangles with the same perimeter and different areas, sort quadrilateral play pads and split a garden into equal areas.

math3-perimeter-shapes.title: Community Garden Festival
math3-perimeter-shapes.tagline: Design garden beds, schedule watering, graph the harvest and fence the plots (Units 6–11).
math3-perimeter-shapes.description: A cumulative project for Units 6–11. Students design a community garden: beds split into fractions, equivalent and compared plantings, a watering schedule with liters and elapsed time, a harvest graph and line plot, and bed areas and fence perimeters.
